inquiry.todo: Set inquiry.endpoint in this file, or the PUBLIC_INQUIRY_ENDPOINT environment variable, to an HTTPS URL that accepts a JSON POST. Until one is set, the quote form opens an email to sales@cosmixengineering.com.

complaint.todo: Create a free Web3Forms access key for info@cosmixengineering.com at https://web3forms.com and set PUBLIC_WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY at build time. Until then a complaint still receives a reference and can be sent on WhatsApp to After-Sales.
